verses.text: waqaanii hafizun qaahirun jalla maanihu
jamiihal azaa wa khayru lil yawma taa-ihu
ajaaraniyal qahhaaru min jumlatil hidaa
wa khaanat-humu armaahuhum wal madaafihu
lahu jalla kullii wahwa rabbii wa haafizii
bihi tantafii hannil balaa wal waqaa-ihu
lahu sirtu habdan wal muqafaa wasiilatii
wa as-haabahu usdal ahadi udaarihu
huwal laahu yahmiinii wa yahmii jamiiha maa
liyaj taara fid daarayni wal laahu waasihu
yaqiinil azaa fadlan wa yuhtiiniyal munaa
bihi tantafii hannii dawaaman qawaatihu
haliimun hakiimun qad hamaanii bihikmatin
wa yakfii janaabii sharra maa huwa waaqihu
salaatan wa tasliiman minal laahi abtaghii
liman kaana bit tahaati habdan yusaarihu
muhammadinil munjii dawaaman khadiimahu
mahal aali wal as-haabi nihmal mutaawihu
karimun bihi arjuu minal laahi hismatan
wa haafiyatad daarayni wal laahu naafihu
minal laahi rabbin naasi arjuu sahaadatan
wa an yaqbalal ahmaala wal laahu raafihu
najaatii wa injaa-i wa hawzis tiqaamatan
uhaawiluhaa bil laahi wal qalbu qaanihu
ilal laahi bil qur-aani was sunnatil latii
hadatnii saraftul kulla wal qalbu khaashihu
lahu sirtu bil qur-aani habdan khadiima man
lahu khidmatii shawqan lahu wahwa shaafihu
nabiyyul hudaa bahrun nadaa dayghamul hidaa
manil juudu yanfil faqra was sayfu qaatihu
ilal mustafaa khayril baraayaa muhammadin
salaatun minal laahil lazii huwa jaamihu
salaamun halal mahii mahar rusli wal malaa
minal waahidil qahhaari man huwa maanihu
